description: This file is a Python script that acts as a wrapper for the mypy linter, handling command execution, parsing mypy output, and managing lint messages.

classes.name: LintSeverity
classes.description: Enumeration of severity levels for lint messages.

classes.name: LintMessage
classes.description: NamedTuple representing a lint message with details such as file, line, code, severity, and description.

methods.name: run_command
methods.description: Executes a command with retries and logs execution time.

methods.name: check_mypy_installed
methods.description: Checks if mypy is installed by running 'mypy -V'.

methods.name: check_files
methods.description: Runs mypy on a list of files and parses the output into lint messages.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main function that parses arguments, configures logging, determines files to lint, and outputs lint messages.
